measurementMethod.silhouetteMask: Subject pixels satisfy min(R,G,B) < 235 against the opaque near-white ground. This produces numerical landmarks only; no altered or derived image was made.
measurementMethod.barkLandmarkClass: Warm-mass samples satisfy R > 1.08*G, R > 1.20*B, R > 45. This is used only to locate visible trunk and branch bands, not to extract a texture or material.
measurementMethod.scopeLimit: Screen-space contour and color bands cannot recover camera focal length, depth, rear topology, or world dimensions. All such construction choices remain inferred.

canopyCrossSection.reading: left lobe, narrow central support/overlap, separated right lobe

warmMassBands.reading: two visible upper structural directions under the high lobe
central shaft/leftward fork and rightward branch support
left branch/rib cluster, central shaft, and right branch: preserves the irregular central window between them
root collar spreads asymmetrically from trunk
three broad visible root sectors across the lower silhouette
separated front-left and front-right toe bands; other toes are higher/occluded in this view

builderUse.frontReview: Declare a source-facing perspective framing, then compare the high peak, three-lobe row at y=0.34, trunk continuity at y=0.60, and lower root spread at y=0.82. These are guide landmarks, not an automatic IoU acceptance score.
builderUse.volumeReview: Rear, both sides, and three-quarter views must prove five closed buttresses, fork attachments, and canopy depth independently of the source-facing mask.
builderUse.prohibitedShortcut: Do not satisfy front contour landmarks with a front skin, flat cutout, textured silhouette, or radial root fan.

curvatureCheckpoints.observed: The visible warm core is centered near x=0.52 at the lower collar, occupies x=0.4023–0.6307 at y=0.60, then moves through the fork/leader bands around x=0.48–0.61 at y=0.42–0.48. This supports a restrained changing trunk direction, rather than a vertical cylinder. Occlusion prevents recovery of an exact centerline.
curvatureCheckpoints.inferredConstruction: Use an offset loop loft with its lower collar center at X=0, a mid-shaft center approximately X=+0.10 m, a fork center approximately X=+0.22 m, and an upper-leader attachment approximately X=+0.28–0.34 m. Alternate each ring's tangent orientation by 8–15 degrees. This is a modest visible sweep within the common 5.0–6.0 m height contract, not an exaggerated serpentine curve.
curvatureCheckpoints.rootPaths: Each buttress is a tapered, tangent-oriented strip descending from the closed collar through two or three control sections. Its projected path must curve outward and down to an unequal toe; at least the front-left and front-center/right paths must have distinct X/Z curvature, while front/back offsets make the side view show more than radial flat fins.
curvatureCheckpoints.branchPaths: The left, right, and upper limbs begin from split shared trunk rings. Loft 4–5 tapered elliptical sections along a shallow curved path with each section oriented to the path tangent; use a small elbow and changing taper, never a straight cylinder or an intersecting rod. Side review must retain non-zero Y displacement and a visible arc for every major limb.
